nodes.label: Find Skills Skill
nodes.rationale: Requires quality verification before recommending skills: prefer 1K+ installs, reputable sources (vercel-labs, anthropics, microsoft), and repos with 100+ GitHub stars to avoid recommending untrusted third-party skills.

nodes.label: Global Promise-based useConfirm System
nodes.rationale: Confirm dialogs are awaited as Promises via context (ConfirmContext + ConfirmProvider resolverRef) so any component can 'await confirm()'. Hotfix 2.2.1 isolates clicks with preventDefault/stopPropagation in the capturing phase to prevent ghost clicks on focused elements beneath the modal; framer-motion spring animation (bounce 0.3, duration 0.4).

nodes.label: Zustand useSyncStore Logout Guard
nodes.rationale: usePhotoUpload calls startSync()/finishSync() (in finally) on the Zustand useSyncStore; useAuth.logout blocks sign-out while isSyncing is true and shows a toast warning, so background photo uploads are never lost by logging out mid-upload.

nodes.label: Standardized lucide-react Icon System
nodes.rationale: Legacy icon libraries (@heroicons/react, react-icons, @fortawesome, Google Material Symbols fonts) were fully removed in favor of a single lucide-react icon system with consistent sizing and animate-spin loading indicators.

nodes.label: Strict Time Tracking Logic (timeTracking.ts)
nodes.rationale: startWork(siteId) INSERTs a time_entries row with start_time and sets site status to in_progress, backfilling actual_start if NULL. completeWork(siteId) backfills actual_start and inserts a closed entry when work is completed without starting, and closes all open entries (end_time IS NULL). Mutations invalidate admin_activity_feed, admin_dashboard_stats and admin_active_sites_online query keys for live admin updates.

nodes.label: Mobile Auto-Navigation After Start Work
nodes.rationale: After pressing 'Pradėti darbą' in the list, installers are auto-redirected to /m/site/{id} so they don't have to hunt for a 'Continue work' button.

nodes.label: Installer Management Module Plan
nodes.rationale: Planned admin module replacing the inactive 'Montuotojai' (Beta) menu item: installer profiles with search/status filtering, per-installer statistics (completed sites, time entries, efficiency), and invitation/creation/permission management.

nodes.label: Karpathy Guidelines Skill
nodes.rationale: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes: think before coding (surface assumptions and trade-offs), simplicity first (no speculative abstractions), surgical changes (touch only what you must, every changed line traces to the request), goal-driven execution (define verifiable success criteria and loop until verified). Biases toward caution over speed.

nodes.label: Installer-app Tech Stack
nodes.rationale: React (Vite) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS frontend; Zustand for global/auth state, TanStack Query for server-state caching of Supabase data; Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage) backend.

nodes.label: Sites Data Model (code, system_type)
nodes.rationale: Sites are identified by 'code' (e.g. SITE-001) and 'client_name' — the earlier 'project_code' column was renamed, so all queries must use 'code'. Creating sites requires the system_type field ('PV', 'BESS', 'PV+BESS', 'OTHER'). Statuses: pending, in_progress, paused, completed.

nodes.label: Role-Based Routing (admin / installer)
nodes.rationale: After Supabase.auth login the profile is read from user_profiles; admin routes to /admin and installer to /mobile via ProtectedRoute, and the root route redirects a logged-in user to their module.

nodes.label: Shared CreateSiteModal Component
nodes.rationale: CreateSiteModal was extracted into src/components/admin/CreateSiteModal.tsx so that site creation has a single code source used by both the Dashboard and the Sites.tsx (all sites) page.

nodes.label: LiveAdminTimer Live Time Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Dashboard 'Šiandien dirba' section uses LiveAdminTimer.tsx which takes the start_time of the open time_entries record (!e.end_time) and counts duration live; if no open entry exists it falls back safely to '0h 0min 0s' (defensive prop checking is a stated project practice).

nodes.label: Silent Time Tracking (Installer UI)
nodes.rationale: Installers are paid per completed work (kW), not per hour, so all time-tracking UI (weeklyHours, daily totals on SiteCard) was removed from the installer view to avoid confusion. Time is still tracked silently: 'PRADĖTI DARBĄ' sets status in_progress and quietly INSERTs a time_entries row; 'PAUZĖ'/'UŽBAIGTI DARBĄ' find the open session and set end_time = now(), so admin-side time accounting stays correct without a visible timer.

nodes.label: Server-Side Sorting by scheduled_start
nodes.rationale: getInstallerSites sorts with .order('scheduled_start', { nullsFirst: false }) on the server. This works because sorting targets the base sites table — Supabase .order() on joined tables previously failed, which had forced client-side Array.sort(). Direction is passed via { ascending }: Today.tsx ascending, Sites.tsx descending; the client-side sort was removed.

nodes.label: Checklist Grouping by Phases
nodes.rationale: In SiteDetail.tsx tasks are grouped into a single 'Darbai' tab by phases (pre, during, post); checkbox changes sync in real time to the site_checklists table, and uploading a photo automatically marks the task complete and attaches a thumbnail preview.

nodes.label: TanStack Query Invalidation Practice
nodes.rationale: After every mutation (pause, site start, etc.) queryClient.invalidateQueries() must be called so lists refresh without a page reload.

nodes.label: Installer App HTML Shell & Theme Pre-paint Script
nodes.rationale: Vite entry HTML with PWA/mobile-web-app meta (apple-touch-icon, black-translucent status bar, Reenpro title) and an inline script that applies the persisted or system dark theme class on documentElement before first paint to avoid a theme flash.

nodes.label: Objekto Kortelė (Site Card) Design Concept
nodes.rationale: Standalone HTML idea mockup for the admin site-detail card: dark sidebar layout with tabs 'Objekto info', 'Įranga' (equipment table with category badges for inverter/modules/BESS/cables/mounting), 'Stringavimas' (string layout dark box + upload area), 'Failai & vizualizacijos', and 'Checklist'.

nodes.label: RLS Security Test Plan
nodes.rationale: 20 SQL checks split into 10 that must pass (admin sees all sites, installer sees only site_assignments-linked sites, installer can open/close own time_entries, update assigned site_checklists, insert photos, update own user_profiles) and 10 that must be blocked (cross-installer reads, installer INSERT into sites/site_assignments/checklist_templates, editing closed time_entries — the UPDATE policy requires end_time IS NULL — and editing other users' profiles). Uses Supabase 'Impersonate role' in SQL Editor for auth context.

nodes.label: Row Level Security Policies (Supabase)
nodes.rationale: RLS governs sites, site_assignments, time_entries, site_checklists, checklist_templates, photos, and user_profiles: admins have full access; installers are scoped to assigned sites via site_assignments and to their own rows via auth.uid(); checklist_templates are readable by all authenticated users but writable only by admins; closed time entries are immutable.
